rules: Use tracking-tighter for H1 (Hero/Main Heading) and H2.
Use uppercase tracking-[0.2em] for overlines and category labels.
CRITICAL: Do not use Inter or generic sans fonts for headings. The typography must convey technical authority and heavy engineering weight.
Variable weights: Use font-black for numbers/stats and font-medium for standard headings.
High-Contrast Technical Authority: Deep graphite base paired with Pure White text for clarity and Industrial Amber/Orange for actions.
Never use pure black #000000 or pure grey. Always tint neutrals with a cool slate/blue undertone.
Use brand_primary (Amber) strictly for CTAs, active states, and to color the 'sponge balls' in the animation.

grids.primary_layout: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A - Tetris Grid) for visual sections.
grids.technical_layout: High Density Grid (Mode B) for technical specifications and data metrics. Tight gaps (gap-4).
rules: Grid Children MUST be direct children.
Expose the Skeleton: For specs and data, use a 'border-collapse' style technical look with visible 1px borders (border-border/40) between items.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing: Use p-8, p-12 for internal card paddings, and massive py-24 or py-32 for vertical section spacing.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content for readability. Only center hero text if structurally supported.
layouts.header: MUST NOT be transparent. Use a solid background (bg-[#09090B]) with a hard 1px bottom border to preserve legibility and industrial rigidity.
sections: Hero: Strong value proposition, overlay on industrial image.
Product Overview: Clean text, bold typography.
How It Works: Interactive/Animated visual of the condenser tube process.
Key Benefits & ROI: Metric-heavy grid layout.
Trust/Case Studies: Client logos (text/icon based) and testimonials.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Avoid glassmorphism as it feels too consumer-tech. Use flat solid surfaces with sharp 1px borders to simulate milled metal and structural integrity.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp (rounded-none) or very minimal radius (rounded-sm) to maintain the brutalist engineering aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay to the main background to break digital flatness.

component_rules.buttons: Rectangular, sharp edges. Primary button uses solid Amber background with black text. Secondary button uses transparent background with 1px border and white text.
component_rules.cards: Flat background, 1px border. On hover: subtle -translate-y-1 and border color shift. No heavy drop shadows.
component_rules.inputs: Use Shadcn components. Override rounded borders to rounded-none or rounded-sm. Dark backgrounds with high-contrast borders.
component_rules.icons: Use lucide-react with stroke-width 1.5 to maintain crisp, technical line work.

motion.sponge_ball_animation: CRITICAL: In the 'How it works' section, create an SVG diagram of condenser tubes. Use Framer Motion to animate small #F59E0B circles (representing the cleaning sponge balls) flowing along the tube paths. This visually explains the 'online cleaning without shutdown' concept.
motion.interactions: Subtle, snappy micro-interactions. Transition transforms (e.g., translate-y) and border colors on hover. No 'transition: all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on dark background meets WCAG AAA standards. Use bg-black/60 overlay on hero image.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='demo-form-submit').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the sponge ball animation.

hero_background.description: Nuclear power plant cooling tower at night, providing a dramatic industrial backdrop. Must be darkened with bg-black/60 overlay.

technical_background.description: Grayscale metal pipes for use as a structural background graphic in the Tech Specs or How It works section.

industry_showcase.description: Grey industrial equipment to visually anchor the Industries Served section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium, one-page B2B industrial landing page for VOCCSYS.
Target Audience: Plant engineers, procurement heads. Vibe must be 'Technical Authority'.
Files are .js and .jsx, do not output .tsx files. Use standard React JSX.
Implement a text-based wordmark for the VOCCSYS logo (font-black tracking-tighter). Do not use an image logo.
Hero Section: Feature a strong value prop ('Online Cleaning Without Plant Shutdown'). Use the provided 'hero_background' URL with a heavy dark overlay.
How It Works: Create an SVG and Framer Motion based animation illustrating sponge balls (orange dots) flowing through condenser tubes and recirculating.
ROI & Benefits: Display specific data points (Fuel Savings, Heat Rate Improvement, Reduced Downtime, ROI in months) using massive typography for numbers.
Industries Served: Use lucide-react icons (e.g., Zap for Power, Snowflake for HVAC, Factory for Petrochemical) in a grid layout.
Trust & Logos: Instead of placeholder image URLs, construct clean, text/icon-based faux logos (e.g., Lucide Hexagon + 'Apex Steel') to represent case studies.
Request Demo: Build a fully functional UI form using standard html/Tailwind inside a structured grid, ensuring a technical, rigid aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' AI outputs. Do not use centered, fluffy SaaS layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements (borders, grid lines) rather than soft drop shadows.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like opacity, border-color, and transform.
Do NOT center align the app container. Respect optical alignment and reading flow.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters.
Use Sonner for toasts (ensure to include data-testid).
Prioritize Shadcn UI patterns but strip out soft, consumer-friendly stylings (remove heavy radii, remove soft shadows).
